aria: Quick kickoff  need a compact benchmark narrative for launch: 3 visuals, 2 headline tones, a one-line sales calc, and routing rules.
nate: Agreed. slices: short-chat, long-agent, embeddings. small runs only.
lucy: Chart specs: 1) median vs $/1k tokens scatter; 2) percentile ladder p50..p99; 3) per-slice bars (baseline vs cache+batch).
aria: Headlines: A) "Bench-backed serving: predictable tails and clear unit economics." B) "Faster answers, smaller bills." Keep hero conservative ("up to").
nate: Sales calc sample: "Baseline $0.00045/token => $450 per 1M; cache+batch ~45% lower => ~$248 per 1M."
lucy: Routing: tag bench on prompt upload; demo if monthly tokens >10M; enterprise if VPC/SAML.
bench-bot: queued quick-run. use `/bench quick --model rwd-mini --slices short,long,embed --tokens 2000 --seeds 2` to start. outputs: CSV + 3 PNGs + summary.
aria: Timeline: visuals Mon EOD, copy Tue AM, webinar Wed. Drop PNGs here when ready.
